disaster.title: Bangladesh: Monsoon Depression in Cox's Bazar

research.text:
Status: monsoon flooding and landslides in July 2026; no report after about 18 July says whether waters are still high.
Places: Ukhiya upazila (Cox's Bazar): 14 deaths, 13 of them Rohingya refugees killed in landslides in the camps. Chakaria upazila (Cox's Bazar): 6 deaths, 1 missing. Teknaf upazila (Cox's Bazar): hardest hit. Ramu, Pekua and Matamuhuri upazilas (Cox's Bazar): flooded. Bandarban and Chattogram districts: landslides and flooding.
Figures: 32 deaths in Cox's Bazar (19 residents, 13 Rohingya) according to the Ministry of Disaster Management; 46 deaths from floods, flash floods and landslides according to the Dhaka Tribune on 12 July; 374 unions and 4 municipalities in 56 upazilas affected according to IFRC on 18 July. Displaced: not reported.
Donation pages: none found.
